Supports Seasons of Skyrim by loading *.SPR|SUM|AUT|WIN.CGID files according to current season. Also sets recommended ini settings automatically for easier grass precache generation and usage. Compatible with SE/AE/VR/GOG all versions.
State.Name: Grass Cache Helper NG

State.Author: Kasplat
State.Description: Allows for the reconfiguration of the max level and max effective level for skills. Fixes a number of bugs in the original implementation and adds new features. Compatible with both SE and AE.
State.Name: Skyrim Skill Uncapper for SE and AE

State.Author: SlavicPotato
State.Description: Fixes the game applying wrong movement speed if the character draws, sheathes or shouts while sprinting or sneaking. SKSE64 plugin.
State.Name: Sprint Sneak Movement Speed Fix

Original.Name: Horse Mount and Dismount Double Sound Fix-99621-1-0-2-1706717975.7z

State.Author: Ersh
State.Description: A SKSE plugin that lets annotated events in paired animations work like in normal animations. Also causes the game to create synchronized animation bindings on demand, freeing up a few hundred animation slots for use by animation replacers. Supports SE/AE/VR. Open source.
State.Name: Paired Animation Improvements

State.Author: SimonMagus
State.Description: Arena is a complete overhaul of Skyrim’s encounter zones designed to increase the game’s difficulty and provide an organic sense of progression.
State.Name: Arena - An Encounter Zone Overhaul

State.Author: Simon Magus - DeltaRider - Oreo
State.Description: Artificer is a complete overhaul of Skyrim's artifacts, designed to distribute Thaumaturgy and Mysticism enchantments throughout the game while ensuring that non-crafting characters can find powerful weapons and armor through questing.
State.Name: Artificer - An Artifact Overhaul

State.Author: SarthesArai
State.Description: Makes radiant quest no longer send you to locations outside of the province of Skyrim.
State.Name: Quests Are In Skyrim

State.Author: doodlum
State.Description: dTry's SKSE plugins ported to 1.6.640/NG in a FOMOD installer. Includes Key Utils, Combat Music Fix, Stop On Slash, Shield Of Stamina, No Crime Teleport RE, Elden Parry, Elden Counter.
State.Name: dTry Plugin Updates

State.Author: Ersh
State.Description: A SKSE framework plugin that replaces animations depending on configurable conditions. In-game editor. Backwards compatible with more features. Extensible by other SKSE plugins. Supports SE/AE/VR. Open source.
State.Name: Open Animation Replacer

State.Author: Catir
State.Description: Tweaks True HUD's boss bar feature to be much stricter in its selection, reserving boss bars for bosses that are important to the story or have unique mechanics. Includes full Creation Club support and support for several quest mods.
State.Name: Curated Bosses for True HUD
